title: Deliver Livestock to Suningley Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Livestock** delivered to **Suningley Factory** (industry id 13, near tile 159,152).

A likely supplier is **Flonningstone Farm** (industry id 14, near tile 176,153); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **250 units** within the horizon.

**Promise:** within the first 30 game-days, commit to a delivery quantity with `rh promise quantity=N` (the last promise before the deadline counts; max 650). You are paid for min(delivered, promised) and fined for any shortfall, so promise what you can really deliver: over- and under-promising both cost you.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
